\caption{The pricing door under the demand-only programme shock. Rows are the door
and its parameter, columns the financing closures; each block reports the change in
the price level ($\Delta P$, the GDP deflator; signed), the largest sectoral price
deviation ($\max|\Delta p|$), employment ($\Delta L$), household consumption
($\Delta W$) and the markup rent's share of factor income ($\Pi/Y$), all in percent
against the reference continuation. Panels A--C hold the real wage fixed (the
\textsc{gamma} gauge); panel D is the mobile-labour robustness row under the CPI
numeraire, where employment is fixed and prices move relative to the CPI. The
$\delta = 0$ row reproduces the fixed-wage column of Table~\ref{tab:results-matrix}
exactly ($\kappa = 0$ does too). $\delta$ is the value-added elasticity of
equation~\eqref{eq:capacity-door}; ``all'' applies it to every sector, ``goods'' sets $\delta = 0$ on the
services sectors (CPA G--T). $s$ is the household saving rate. Generated from the
\texttt{pricing\_\{capacity,mobile\}-v2-*} (capacity door, OpenCGE v0.2.1) and
\texttt{pricing\_\{markup,profit,mobile\}-v1-*} (markup door, v0.2.0) run
manifests; no number is hand-typed.}
\label{tab:pricing-door}
